title: dirt_worlds
body:
🟫 dirt_world - the mod which makes the earth even dirty
Do you want a useless mod?
A mod that is useless except to make people laugh (or cry)?
Dirt_world is there for you.

🌍 What the mod adds:
🕳️ A 100% dirt dimension
You open a portal… and BIM: an entire universe made of Dirt.
No diamonds. No beauty. Just ... earth. Everywhere
. Everywhere. EVERYWHERE.

🧱 A block of ugly dirt ™
It’s a block.
He's ugly.
And he is on the ground.

🧠 Why install this mod?
To train to survive in despair.

To make jokes to your friends ("Go ahead, go to the portal 👀")

To rediscover the emotional power of the Dirt.
Because the ugly block needs love.

📦 Compatibility:
✅ Minecraft 1.20.x
✅ Works with manufacture / forge
✅ Do not break anything except your dignity

🗣️ "I entered the world ... I am no longer the same."
- a traumatized player

📥 Download Dirt_World
And offer yourself the dirtiest void in Minecraft.
